title: Settings
description: Switches and limits that take effect from the next request, without a restart.
readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
empty: There are no settings to show.
refreshFailed: Could not refresh the latest settings — showing the version loaded earlier.
saveFailed: Could not save. Please try again.
integerRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
vetoedNote: Turned off by the server configuration; the stored value applies once it is lifted.
degradedNote: The settings store is unavailable, so a safe fallback applies.

source.VETOED: Turned off by the server configuration

enabled.label: AI assistant
enabled.help: Turning it off takes effect from the next question; guide articles and requests keep working.

daily_ceiling.label: Questions per day, all askers
daily_ceiling.help: The assistant pauses for the day once this many questions were answered.

member_daily_quota.label: Questions per member per day
member_daily_quota.help: How many questions one signed-in member may ask each day.

guest_daily_quota.label: Questions per guest per day
guest_daily_quota.help: How many questions one guest may ask each day.

guest_network_daily_quota.label: Questions per guest network per day
guest_network_daily_quota.help: How many questions all guests behind one network address may ask each day.

enabled.label: Auto-close resolved requests
enabled.help: Closes a resolved request when the member neither replies nor confirms it in time.

resolved_days.label: Days before a resolved request closes
resolved_days.help: Counted from when the member first opened the resolved request. 1 to 90 days.

enabled.label: Email members about replies
enabled.help: Sends the member one email when an admin replies. While it is off, replies wait and are mailed once it is turned back on.

window_minutes.label: Minutes to group replies into one email
window_minutes.help: Replies sent within this window reach the member as one email. 0 sends right away; at most 1440 minutes.

enabled.label: Delete old closed requests
enabled.help: Permanently deletes closed requests, with their messages and images, once they are older than the retention period. Other statuses are never deleted.

closed_request_months.label: Months to keep a closed request
closed_request_months.help: Counted from the request's last activity. 6 to 120 months.
